slides.title: The council’s 90% target counts on-time departures only, so lost mileage can rise unseen

lines.text: On time
Departing a timing point between 1 minute early and 5 minutes 59 seconds late, as a share of timetabled departures
Lost mileage
Timetabled kilometres not run, as a share of all timetabled kilometres
Excess wait
Average minutes a passenger waits beyond the scheduled interval, on frequent routes only

notes.heading: The measure this review reports
notes.text: Every figure in this review is on-time departures: the share of timetabled departures leaving a timing point from 1:00 early to 5:59 late. OVT performance methodology v3, §2

notes.heading: The target’s blind spot
notes.text: The council’s 90% target counts on-time departures only, so lost mileage can rise without moving it. This comes from the committee minutes, a secondary relay of the target’s terms. The pack holds no Q3 lost-mileage figures. OVT performance methodology v3, §4 Council transport committee minutes, 3 Jun 2026, item 6

sources.text: Council transport committee minutes, 3 Jun 2026, item 6

notes.heading: Frequent routes only
notes.text: Excess wait is measured only where buses run to an interval rather than a timetable. OVT performance methodology v3, §5

sources.text: Council transport committee minutes, 3 Jun 2026, item 6

notes.heading: Bridge works in three phases
notes.text: Phase 1 (7 July–3 August) closed one lane; phase 2 (4 August–28 September) closed Mill Street fully, with a 1.8 km diversion; phase 3 (from 29 September) reopened one lane with evening closures. County highways notice HW-0412

notes.heading: The October figure
notes.text: On-time departures on route 12 Cross-town fell a further 4 points in October, while phase 3’s evening closures were in place. OVT performance dashboard, October 2026

notes.heading: Planning’s reading
notes.text: Service planning attributes the October dip to phase 3’s evening closures of Mill Street, which hit the two routes that cross it. Depot staffing report, Oct 2026 (dispute recorded)

notes.heading: The depot’s reading
notes.text: The depot reports 6 driver vacancies in October, which would cut recovery time on every route. The depot manager’s view, as summarised in the pack: {vacancies, not roadworks, explain October} (paraphrased by the brief’s author, not a quote). Depot staffing report, Oct 2026

notes.heading: What would settle it
notes.text: Only routes 12 and 14 Cross-town dipped in October, which favours planning, but the evidence is one month and both readings stay open. Other routes’ October figures, or the January check after retiming, would separate them. OVT performance dashboard, October 2026
